title: Meet the minds behind Soft Bee

members.name: Andrii Havryliuk
members.description: A visionary leader with 10+ years in tech, Andrii ensures every project aligns with business goals. He believes that great software is built on transparency, robust engineering, and a relentless attention to detail. His strategic approach drives our team to consistently deliver exceptional value.

members.name: Yurii Moldavchuk
members.description: As a co-founder, Yurii brings strategic visions to life, ensuring our solutions are both highly functional and user-centric. He bridges the gap between business strategy, user needs, and product excellence, driving innovation and maintaining a high standard of quality across all our digital products.

members.name: Mykyta Kaidash
members.description: Designs system architecture, leads implementation, and supports engineering quality across projects. Mykyta ensures the technical foundation is robust and built to handle future growth, while mentoring developers and championing best practices.

members.name: Vitaliy Pushkarov
members.description: Develops modern user interfaces with a focus on usability, performance, and consistency. Vitaliy is passionate about creating pixel-perfect, accessible, and highly interactive frontend experiences that delight users. His attention to detail bridges the gap between design and seamless functionality.

members.name: Anton Mazurenko
members.description: Builds cross-platform mobile applications with a focus on performance and user experience. Anton leverages React Native to deliver fluid, native-like mobile experiences on both iOS and Android. He consistently optimizes complex animations and ensures smooth data synchronization across devices.

members.name: Polina Samokysh
members.description: Develops brand positioning, identity, and communication consistency across channels. Polina creates compelling visual narratives that resonate with our target audience and elevate the company's presence. She ensures every touchpoint reflects our core values and aesthetic vision.
